title: Login still reads the old setting
scope: Example report · Fictional app and evidence
context: A recent change renamed the login setting. The login code still uses its old name, so it receives no client ID.

rca.summary: The settings define authClientId, but login asks for clientId. The lookup returns no value, which fits the missing-ID error.

checks.evidence: The configuration uses authClientId. Login still reads settings.clientId.
Login reports “Missing client ID” when the value is absent.

history.summary: The last settings edit renamed clientId to authClientId. The login reader was unchanged.

gaps: Login has not been rerun with matching setting names.

sources.label: Login reader (example)
sources.excerpt:
const clientId = settings.clientId;
if (!clientId) throw new Error("Missing client ID");

nodes.label: Settings: authClientId
nodes.detail: The current configuration provides authClientId. The old key, clientId, was removed.

nodes.label: Login reads clientId
nodes.detail: Login still asks for settings.clientId. It has not followed the rename.

nodes.label: Lookup returns no value
nodes.detail: The requested key is absent from the configuration. The settings and login reader disagree.

nodes.label: Login reports a missing ID
nodes.detail: This missing value fits the reported login error. The report identifies the mismatch; it does not claim login has recovered.
